nav.description: Manage this project, who can use it and how it is accessed.

project.descriptionOwner: Name and describe the project, and decide when flags count as cleanup candidates.
project.descriptionReadOnly: Only owners can change these settings.
project.slugHint: Used in URLs and the CLI. The slug cannot be changed.
project.daysError: Enter a whole number of days between 1 and 3650

cleanup.description: Flags that match these rules are listed as cleanup candidates, so dead code and forgotten rollouts do not pile up.
cleanup.staleAfterHint: A flag is stale when it has had no changes for this long.
cleanup.singleVariantHint: A flag is a cleanup candidate when it has served only one variant to everyone for this long.

dangerZone.title: Danger zone
dangerZone.description: These actions affect your access or remove data for good.

leave.description: You lose access to {{name}} until an owner invites you again.
leave.soleOwner: You are the only owner. Make another member an owner first.
leave.confirmDescription: You will lose access to this project. An owner can invite you again.

delete.description: Permanently delete the project with its flags, segments, environments, SDK keys and audit log.
delete.confirmDescription: This permanently deletes all flags, segments, environments, API keys and the audit log of this project. SDKs using its keys will stop receiving flags.

environments.description: Environments hold separate flag configuration and SDK keys. The order here is the order used across the app.

empty.title: No environments
empty.description: Flags are configured per environment. Add one to start evaluating flags.

environments.keepOne: A project must keep at least one environment

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: The flag configuration and the SDK keys of this environment are removed. Applications using those keys stop receiving flags. This cannot be undone.

dialog.addDescription: Every flag gets a disabled configuration in the new environment.
dialog.editDescription: The key identifies the environment in the API and the CLI, so it cannot be changed.
dialog.keyHint: Lowercase letters, digits, dashes and underscores. Generated from the name.
dialog.productionHint: Production environments ask for confirmation before changes and are marked with hazard stripes.

roleDescription.owner: Manages everything, including settings and members.
roleDescription.editor: Changes flags, segments, experiments and schedules.

members.lastOwnerRole: A project needs at least one owner. Make someone else an owner first.
members.selfRemove: Use "Leave project" in General settings to remove yourself
members.lastOwnerRemove: A project needs at least one owner

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.description: {{name}} loses access to this project right away. You can invite them again later.

pending.title: Pending invitations
pending.description: Invitations are accepted in the app by the invitee after signing in.

empty.title: No pending invitations
empty.description: Invite a teammate by email. They will see the invitation after signing in with that address.

pending.cancelDescription: The invitation stops working. You can send a new one at any time.

inviteDialog.description: They will see the invitation after signing in with this email.

sdk.title: SDK keys
sdk.description: Environment-scoped keys for OpenFeature SDKs and anything that speaks OFREP. Keys can only read flags.

empty.title: No SDK keys
empty.description: Create a key to evaluate flags from your application. Each key is tied to one environment.

management.title: Management keys
management.description: Project-scoped keys for the Halyard CLI and the REST API.

empty.title: No management keys
empty.description: Create a key to script this project from CI or log in with the CLI.

revoke.title: Revoke {{name}}?
revoke.descriptionSdk: Applications using this key stop receiving flags right away. This cannot be undone.
revoke.descriptionManagement: Scripts and CLI sessions using this key stop working right away. This cannot be undone.

create.sdkDescription: SDK keys evaluate flags for a single environment. Use one per service so you can revoke them independently.
create.managementDescription: Management keys act on the whole project through the CLI and REST API.
create.environmentHint: The key can only read flags of this environment.
create.readDescription: List and export flags, segments and settings.
create.writeDescription: Also change flags and import configuration.

reveal.title: Copy your new key
reveal.notShownTitle: This key will not be shown again
reveal.notShownDescription: Store it in your secrets manager now. If you lose it, revoke it and create a new one.

export.title: Export
export.description: Take this project's environments, segments and flags with their targeting out of Halyard. Exports hold no keys, statistics or members.

json.title: Halyard JSON
json.description: The complete document. Import it into another project or keep it as a backup.

flagd.title: Export for flagd
flagd.description: One environment as a flagd flag definition file. Anything flagd cannot express exactly is listed below.

import.title: Import
import.description: Apply a Halyard export to this project. Entities are matched by key; the preview shows exactly what would change before anything is written.
import.fileHint: Choose a .json file, or paste the document below.
import.pruneLabel: Remove flags, segments and environments missing from the file
import.pruneOnHint: Anything not in the file is deleted, including its history of targeting and the SDK keys of removed environments. This cannot be undone.
import.pruneOffHint: Off: the import only adds and updates; nothing is deleted.
import.viewerTitle: Importing needs the editor or owner role
import.viewerDescription: Viewers can export this project but not change it. Ask an owner for a higher role.
import.invalidJson: This is not valid JSON. Paste or upload a Halyard export file.
import.problems_one: {{count}} problem in the document, nothing can be applied
import.problems_other: {{count}} problems in the document, nothing can be applied
import.noChanges: Nothing to change. This project already matches the document.
import.willBeWritten_one: {{count}} change will be written in one step.
import.willBeWritten_other: {{count}} changes will be written in one step.

confirm.title: Apply this import?
confirm.description_one: {{count}} change will be written to this project in one step and take effect immediately.
confirm.description_other: {{count}} changes will be written to this project in one step and take effect immediately.
confirm.deletions_one: {{count}} item will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
confirm.deletions_other: {{count}} items will be deleted. This cannot be undone.

webhooks.description: Send a signed HTTP request to your own server when something changes in this project.
webhooks.testQueuedDescription: It is sent within a few seconds.
webhooks.testFailed: Could not send the test event
webhooks.enableBeforeTest: Enable the webhook before sending a test event

empty.title: No webhooks yet
empty.description: A webhook sends a signed HTTP request to your server whenever something changes in this project: a flag is toggled, a scheduled change runs, a segment is edited. Use it to post to chat, trigger a deploy check or keep another system in sync.

rotate.title: Rotate the secret of {{name}}?
rotate.description: Halyard generates a new signing secret and shows it once. Requests are signed with the new secret right away, so your endpoint rejects them until you update it.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: It stops receiving events and its delivery history is deleted. This cannot be undone.

form.description: Halyard sends a signed POST request to the URL whenever one of the chosen events happens.
form.urlHint: Must start with http:// or https://.
form.secretHint: Halyard generates a secure random secret and shows it once after you create the webhook. Only set your own if your receiver already has one (16 characters or more).

picker.allEventsHint: Every audit log entry, including event types added in the future.

eventDescriptions.flagUpdated: Name, description, tags or variants of a flag changed
eventDescriptions.flagToggled: A flag was turned on or off in an environment
eventDescriptions.flagEnvironmentUpdated: Targeting, rules or fallthrough of a flag changed in an environment
eventDescriptions.flagPromoted: A configuration was copied between environments
eventDescriptions.flagUnarchived: A flag was restored from the archive
eventDescriptions.segmentAll: A segment was created, updated or deleted
eventDescriptions.environmentAll: An environment was created, updated or deleted
eventDescriptions.scheduleFailed: A scheduled change could not be applied
eventDescriptions.memberAll: Members were invited, joined, left, removed or changed role
eventDescriptions.apiKeyAll: An API key was created or deleted
eventDescriptions.webhookAll: Webhooks were created, updated, deleted or rotated

reveal.createdDescription: {{name}} is enabled and will receive the events you chose.
reveal.rotatedDescription: The previous secret of {{name}} no longer works. Update your endpoint.
reveal.copyNowDescription: It is shown only once. If you lose it, rotate the secret to get a new one.
reveal.signatureIs: The signature is <0>{{formula}}</0>. Reject requests older than 5 minutes.

guide.title: Verifying signatures
guide.description: Check that a request really comes from Halyard before you trust it.
guide.intro: Every request carries <0>{{header}}</0>. The signature is the hex HMAC-SHA256, keyed with the webhook secret, of <1>{{payload}}</1>.
guide.verifyBody: Verify the exact bytes of the body before you parse the JSON.
guide.tolerance: Reject requests whose timestamp is more than 5 minutes from your clock, so a captured request cannot be replayed later.
guide.dedupe: Use <0>X-Halyard-Delivery</0> to de-duplicate: delivery is at least once and the id stays the same across retries.

headers.delivery: One delivery of one event to this webhook. Stays the same across retries, so use it to de-duplicate.
headers.timestamp: Unix time in seconds when the request was signed.
headers.signature: Timestamp and HMAC-SHA256 signature. May carry more than one v1 value.

deliveries.title: Deliveries

empty.title: No deliveries yet
empty.description: Deliveries appear here as soon as an event matches this webhook. Send a test event to try it out.

deliveries.refreshing: Refreshing every 15 seconds while deliveries are pending.
deliveries.ownersOnly: Response bodies are visible to owners only.
